links.comparator_used: Institution-specific CI-D models re-developed on single-site data with identical variables and modeling methods, versus multi-institutional CI-D models applied to the single site
links.outcome: Prediction of future care location (routine vs ICU) at >6-12, >12-18, >18-24 and >24-30 hours, measured by AUROC and AUPRC
links.effect: Multi-institutional models applied to the single-site test set: AUROC 0.493-0.545, AUPRC 0.262-0.299. Single-site models: AUROC 0.906-0.944, AUPRC 0.754-0.824.
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) for the multi-institutional CI-D models applied to a single-site test dataset was 0.493-0.545 and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) was 0.262-0.299.
